messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Which requirements does Annex V to Legislative Decree 81/2008 lay down for the emergency stop devices of work equipment built in the absence of product directives?

response.text: Quali requisiti stabilisce l'Allegato V del Decreto Legislativo 81/2008 per i dispositivi di arresto di emergenza delle attrezzature di lavoro costruite in assenza di direttive di prodotto?
